note: Every refusal here is DEMONSTRATED as a produced artifact, never asserted. Python bytecode is purged before every run, because a same-byte-length restore once left mutated bytecode valid under CPython's mtime-and-size cache check and the harness reported a restore as still red.
what_this_shows: reports/guards/refusals.json shows each guard REFUSING when exercised. This artifact shows each TEST DETECTING the guard being disabled. A guard can refuse correctly while its test asserts nothing, and only this catches that.

mutations.name: a whatIf literal is flipped to False
mutations.intent: turn the only order construction in the package into a transmitting one
mutations.defect: this repository transmits no order, ever. The flag that makes every broker interaction a preview is a single literal, and flipping it is the smallest possible edit that would change what the package does at a venue

mutations.name: the whatIf flag is supplied from an expression rather than a literal
mutations.intent: keep the run-time value True while removing the build-time guarantee
mutations.defect: bool(1) evaluates to True, so the package still behaves correctly and every run-time check still passes. What is lost is the STATIC guarantee: a value that is not a literal cannot be verified at build time, and the next edit to whatever supplies it is unreviewed. This is the sharpest of the five, because nothing observable changes

mutations.name: a session trusts its declared environment instead of the connected account
mutations.intent: let configuration state the environment rather than the connection
mutations.defect: config states an INTENT and the connection states a FACT, and the fact wins. This mutation makes the declaration self-certifying, so a session declaring live while connected to a D-prefixed paper account would record its figures as live. Every downstream provenance tag would be a copy of a wish

mutations.name: a paper margin becomes admissible to a gate
mutations.intent: drop MARGIN from the kinds that require a live environment
mutations.defect: a paper margin read is development evidence. Promoting one into a verdict is the single failure the paper-only clause exists to prevent, and after this edit the MARGIN gate would happily fire on a simulated account's number

mutations.name: the deciding latch's spent check is inverted
mutations.intent: invert the condition that makes one spend per registered figure
mutations.defect: the latch exists so a deciding read happens once. An inverted condition is a classic single-token defect and it breaks the guard in both directions: the first spend raises when it should succeed, and a second would succeed when it should raise LatchAlreadySpentError
